discrepancies.report_statement: 60 total runs (50 deterministic runs, 10 GPT-4.1 runs) across 7 domains with GPT-4.1 policy comparison.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: deterministic_runs.jsonl contains 55 runs; gpt41_runs.jsonl contains only 5 runs (seeds 0-4 for predictive_binary only). Only 1 GPT-4.1 planning call occurred (call_id: gpt41_plan_75b5e5ce). In champion_challenger.json, domains 2 to 7 copied deterministic values under gpt41_vs_deterministic without any real GPT-4.1 plan.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Enforce GPT41_POLICY_LABEL_WITHOUT_REAL_PLAN = 0. Execute genuine GPT-4.1 planning calls for all decision-capable domains (Predictive, Deep Learning, Fraud, Recommender, Portfolio, Market Risk). Record discrete call IDs, token telemetry, structured plans, and execute via deterministic engine across 5 seeds.

discrepancies.bundle_truth: sensitivity_results.json contains the canonical 9-point grid: [-0.3, -0.2, -0.1, -0.05, 0.0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3]. The textual reference in the report was a typographical omission of the 30% outer shock bounds.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Enforce canonical 9-point grid [-0.30, -0.20, -0.10, -0.05, 0.00, +0.05, +0.10, +0.20, +0.30] universally across text, JSON, and rerun outputs.

discrepancies.report_statement: Report implies comprehensive XAI support; spec discusses PDP, ICE, ALE, LIME.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: xai_results.json records only Native Gain, Permutation, and SHAP. PDP and ICE are executable via scikit-learn inspection but were not executed in the initial bundle. ALE and LIME are not installed/not implemented in the environment.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Classify XAI methods explicitly: Native, Permutation, SHAP, PDP, ICE as CERTIFIED (after executing PDP and ICE on the real-data champion). Classify ALE and LIME as NOT_EXECUTABLE / DEFERRED.

discrepancies.report_statement: Report Section 2 catalogs Real External datasets (Hugging Face Adult Census, UCI German Credit, Local Parquet).
discrepancies.bundle_truth: Data provider runtime successfully fetched and cached real datasets, but champion/challenger benchmark in champion_challenger.json was executed ONLY on Layer A Golden Known-Answer (institutional_credit_v1). Real-data empirical evaluation was not executed.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Execute full champion/challenger matrix across 5 seeds on real external dataset (scikit-learn/adult-census-income) with semantic feature names, comparing RF, LightGBM, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, and Logistic Regression. Run XAI on the real-data champion.

discrepancies.report_statement: HRP declared universal champion over Min-Var solely because it attained higher Diversification Ratio (3.7886 vs 3.6386). Equal Risk Contribution (ERC) omitted.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: HRP, Min-Var, and ERC optimize fundamentally different objective functions. HRP maximizes tree-based diversification, Min-Var minimizes portfolio variance, and ERC equalizes marginal risk contributions. Universal ranking is scientifically invalid.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Report HRP, Minimum Variance, and ERC simultaneously across multi-objective metrics (realized vol, return, Sharpe, max drawdown, diversification ratio, concentration, Euler reconciliation). Report OBJECTIVE_WINNER for each optimization objective.

discrepancies.report_statement: Cornish-Fisher declared champion over Parametric Gaussian by ranking Kupiec POF p-value (0.5564 vs 0.5064). Historical Simulation omitted.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: Kupiec POF tests the null hypothesis H_0: coverage == 0.01. A higher p-value above alpha=0.05 does not imply monotonic model superiority. Historical Simulation was missing from the benchmark.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Evaluate Historical Simulation, Parametric Gaussian, and Cornish-Fisher across 5 seeds. Report full calibration diagnostics (exceptions, expected exceptions, coverage deviation, Kupiec LR, Kupiec p-value, 99% VaR, 99% ES) without claiming a single scalar winner.

discrepancies.report_statement: Table reports FFM vs FM ranking performance.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: NCF and MF are fully implemented in start.recommender.models but were omitted from the 5-seed benchmark table. Real recommender data was not evaluated.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Execute complete 4-model comparison (FFM, NCF, MF, FM) across 5 seeds on golden fixture. For real external data, truthfully record RECOMMENDER_REAL_DATA_CERTIFICATION = BLOCKED due to missing production recommender provider adapter.

discrepancies.report_statement: Deep Learning domain only certifies Tabular PyTorch MLP.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: start.modeling contains SequenceClassifier (LSTM, GRU) and VisionCNNClassifier (simple_cnn_small). These were not benchmarked on appropriate task datasets.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Execute task-appropriate bounded 5-seed benchmarks for Tabular MLP (tabular data), Sequence LSTM and GRU (sequence data), and Vision CNN (vision image data). Record loss curves, val metrics, test metrics, and best epochs.

discrepancies.report_statement: Fraud domain reports only Balanced Random Forest (PR-AUC = 0.2950).
discrepancies.bundle_truth: No challenger models (LightGBM, XGBoost, Gradient Boosting, Logistic Regression) were evaluated on the imbalanced dataset.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Retain PR-AUC = 0.2950 ± 0.1285 as real empirical result. Evaluate executable challengers with class weighting across 5 seeds. Classify empirical performance based on descriptive criteria.

discrepancies.report_statement: Invariant table describes ES >= VaR as 'Sub-additivity coherence'.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: ES >= VaR verifies that Expected Shortfall is a conservative tail measure that upper-bounds VaR at the same confidence level. It does not by itself prove subadditivity ES(X+Y) <= ES(X) + ES(Y), which requires a multi-asset portfolio test.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Correct invariant terminology to 'Expected Shortfall Tail Conservatism / Upper Bound (ES_alpha >= VaR_alpha)'. Execute an explicit 2-asset subadditivity check if claiming subadditivity coherence.

discrepancies.topic: Distributed Data Runtime vs Local Partitioning
discrepancies.report_statement: Specification references Ray Data integration check.
discrepancies.bundle_truth: Ray is not installed in the environment (ray_installed: False). Data execution uses deterministic single-node PyArrow columnar partitioning.
discrepancies.reconciliation: Explicitly report RAY_AVAILABLE = 0 and RAY_DISTRIBUTED_EXECUTION_VERIFIED = 0 in all manifests and authoritative reports.
